_what_this_is: every inbound and outbound path as a RECORD, derived from the golden tables — not a paragraph inside a claim
_why: prose is not reliable knowledge. Nothing can query a paragraph, diff it next month, or notice when it goes stale.
_ours_is_decided_by_author: never by prefix. The SuccessFactors replication set is SAP-delivered and ACTIVATED here; a Z/Y filter erased the live SF-to-ECC channel from the map earlier today

Con solo el total, ALLOS parece marginal
